newsitem.title: UK: Northern Rock B/S details float plans.
newsitem.headline: Northern Rock B/S details float plans.

text.p: Britain's Northern Rock Building Society on Friday said the final qualifying date for its members to get free shares in its flotation is expected to be August 22.
The flotation and conversion to bank status is still expected on October 1, the society, which is currently mutually owned, said in a statement.

Each of its 900,000 members will receive 500 free shares when the society floats which analysts said are expected to be worth around 350p per share giving a market capitalisation of around 1.5 billion stg.
The value of the shares to each member was calculated at between 1,300 and 1,475 stg by the society's advisers J.P. Morgan but current valuations put this at nearer 1,750 stg.
Northern Rock, which dates back to the 1850s, has assets of around 14 billion stg.

It will be offering members a Shareholder Account where they will be able to keep their shares but said that, unlike other societies which have converted this year, it will not offer a Personal Equity Plan (PEP) because it does not normally offer advice on such products.
